definitions.gloss: to look back; to turn around
definitions.explanation: To physically turn one's head or body to look behind.

definitions.gloss: to reflect on; to look back on
definitions.explanation: To think about or review past events, experiences, or one's own actions.

notes:
{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to swing) + ⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧ (to return). It means to turn back physically or mentally.

ASPECT (ている):
{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}っている indicates the action of looking back is ongoing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (physical) — to turn around
- [period/event]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (figurative) — to reflect on [period/event]
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (look back on the past)
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (reflect on one's life)
- ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (look back on the year)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{向|む}く→振り向く：04232_furimuku⟧: to turn around (only physical, not reflective)
- ⟦{顧|かえり}みる→顧みる：30613_kaerimiru⟧: to reflect on, consider (more literary)
- ⟦{回顧|かいこ}→回顧：12022_kaiko⟧する: to look back on (formal, written)
